Indikator 5 tracks the proportion of patients treated with [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] who receive a [[faeces-calprotectin-maaling|Fæces calprotectin måling]], a key biomarker for monitoring intestinal inflammation. This metric is monitored nationally by the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] [^src1].

**Leaders and Trailers**
In the 2024/25 reporting period, several departments achieved a perfect 100% measurement rate. These leaders include SUH Roskilde Pædiatri, SLB Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling, HOL Holbæk Med. Gastroenterologi, Gødstrup Børn og Unge, and AAUH Aalborg Børne- og Ungeafdeling [^src1]. At the other end of the spectrum, the lowest-performing departments were Aarhus Lever-, Mave- og Tarmsygd. (64%), Herlev Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygd. (67%), Horsens Klinik for Medicinske Sygd. (73%), and Rigshospitalet Sygd. i Fordøjelsessystem, C (75%) [^src1].

**Targets Met and Missed**
The data indicates a compliance threshold of 80%, with departments scoring 80% or higher marked as meeting the target ("Ja") and those below marked as missing it ("Nej") [^src1]. At the national level, Denmark met the target with an 86% compliance rate [^src1]. All five administrative regions also met the target, led by Sjælland (94%) and Nordjylland (93%), while Midtjylland just cleared the threshold at 80% [^src1]. Conversely, several major adult gastroenterology departments missed the target, including Bispebjerg Abdominalcenter K (78%), OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S (79%), and the aforementioned trailing departments [^src1].

**Trends**
Because this comparison is built from a single dated section, no trends across multiple source documents can be established. However, the historical columns within this single table show that the national compliance rate grew from 79% in 2022/23 to 83% in 2023/24, and reached 86% in 2024/25 [^src1].

**Outliers**
A stark structural outlier emerges between pediatric and adult departments. Pediatric units (Børne- og Ungeafdelinger) consistently achieve near-perfect or perfect scores (96–100%), whereas adult medical gastroenterology departments exhibit high variance and frequently fall below the 80% threshold [^src1]. Additionally, Rigshospitalet Sygd. i Fordøjelsessystem, C presents a massive anomaly in its historical data, dropping to just 16% (43 out of 264 patients) in the 2023/24 column before recovering to 75% in 2024/25 [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter i BMSL-behandling med fæces-calprotectin-måling på nationalt, regionalt og afdelingsniveau for 2024/25, 2023/24 og 2022/23, og viser at flere børne- og ungeafdelinger (f.eks. SLB Kolding og SUH Roskilde) opnår 100 %, mens Herlev og OUH Odense Medicinsk Mave-Tarm Afd. S ligger under udviklingsmålet på 75–79 % i 2024/25.
